cards.ex: Our economy is increasingly consumer-driven, relying on people buying more and more things.
cards.exUz: Bizning iqtisodiyotimiz tobora ko'proq iste'molga asoslangan bo'lib, odamlarning ko'proq narsalarni sotib olishiga tayanadi.
cards.uzDef: Iste'molchilarning xohishlari va talablari asosida shakllangan iqtisodiyot yoki jamiyat.

cards.ex: They're trying to corner the market in electric scooters with their new model.
cards.exUz: Ular yangi modeli bilan elektr scooterlar bozorini egallashga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Bozorda bir turdagi mahsulot yoki xizmatni deyarli butunlay nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: That handbag looks like a designer one, but I suspect it's a knock-off.
cards.exUz: Bu sumka dizaynerlikka o'xshaydi, lekin menimcha, bu soxta nusxa.
cards.uzDef: Original mahsulotga o'xshab yasashga urinilgan arzon nusxa.

cards.ex: The supermarket uses milk as a loss leader to get people into the store.
cards.exUz: Supermarket xaridorlarni do'konga jalb qilish uchun sutni zararli sotuv sifatida ishlatadi.
cards.uzDef: Xaridorlarni jalb qilish uchun arzon narxda sotiladigan mahsulot.

cards.ex: The company really hyped up the new phone, but it wasn't that impressive.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi telefonni juda ko'p reklama qildi, lekin u unchalik ta'sirli emas edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida juda ko'p reklama berib, uning ahamiyatini oshirib ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: They went to the mall and shopped 'til they dropped, buying clothes and shoes.
cards.exUz: Ular savdo markaziga borishdi va kiyim-kechak va poyabzal sotib olib, sotib olguncha charchashdi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida ko'p narsalarni sotib olish bilan shug'ullanish.

cards.ex: She always buys brand name clothes, even though they're more expensive.
cards.exUz: U har doim brend nomi ostidagi kiyimlarni sotib oladi, garchi ular qimmatroq bo'lsa ham.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning mashhur va tanilgan mahsulot nomi.

cards.ex: These laptops are going cheap because the new models are coming out soon.
cards.exUz: Bu noutbuklar arzon narxda sotilmoqda, chunki yangi modellari tez orada chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Arzon narxda sotilayotgan mahsulot yoki xizmat.

cards.ex: The company is trying to expand its consumer base by targeting younger people.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yoshlarni nishonga olib, iste'molchilar bazasini kengaytirishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulot yoki xizmatni sotib oladigan odamlar guruhi.

cards.ex: I got hooked on online shopping during the lockdown.
cards.exUz: Men karantin paytida onlayn xarid qilishga qaram bo'lib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirga o'rganib qolish, undan voz kechish qiyin bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company is pushing its new energy drink with a big advertising campaign.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi energiya ichimligini katta reklama kampaniyasi bilan targ'ib qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulotni sotish uchun reklama qilish va targ'ibot olib borish.

cards.ex: The shop doesn't offer refunds, so buyer beware.
cards.exUz: Do'kon qaytarishni taklif qilmaydi, shuning uchun xaridor ehtiyot bo'lsin.
cards.uzDef: Xarid qilishda ehtiyot bo'lish kerakligi haqida ogohlantirish; sifatga kafolat yo'q.

cards.ex: The bottom line is that we need to increase sales to stay in business.
cards.exUz: Yakuniy natija shuki, biz biznesda qolish uchun sotuvlarni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biznesning foyda yoki zarari haqidagi yakuniy ma'lumot.

cards.ex: Their brand recognition is so strong that people buy their products without thinking.
cards.exUz: Ularning brend tanilishi shunchalik kuchliki, odamlar ularning mahsulotlarini o'ylamasdan sotib olishadi.
cards.uzDef: Brendning mashhurligi va uni osonlikcha tanish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: That product is their cash cow, consistently generating huge profits.
cards.exUz: Bu mahsulot ularning daromad manbai bo'lib, doimiy ravishda katta foyda keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va barqaror daromad keltiradigan mahsulot yoki biznes.

cards.ex: The company focuses on customer retention by providing excellent service.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya mukammal xizmat ko'rsatish orqali xaridorlarni saqlab qolishga e'tibor qaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud xaridorlarni doimiy xaridorga aylantirish va ularni yo'qotmaslik.

cards.ex: The new movie launched with a massive marketing blitz across all media platforms.
cards.exUz: Yangi film barcha media platformalarida keng ko'lamli marketing hujumi bilan ishga tushirildi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida juda ko'p reklama va marketing harakatlari.

cards.ex: They live in an upscale neighborhood with expensive houses and fancy cars.
cards.exUz: Ular qimmat uylar va hashamatli mashinalar bilan hashamatli mahallada yashaydilar.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori sifatli, qimmatbaho va boy odamlar uchun mo'ljallangan.

cards.ex: Most of the clothes we buy are mass-produced in factories overseas.
cards.exUz: Biz sotib oladigan kiyimlarning aksariyati chet eldagi fabrikalarda ommaviy ishlab chiqariladi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p miqdorda, tez va arzon usulda ishlab chiqarilgan mahsulot.

cards.ex: That product was a flash in the pan; everyone forgot about it after a few months.
cards.exUz: Bu mahsulot qisqa muddatli muvaffaqiyat edi; bir necha oydan keyin hamma uni unutdi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa muddatli muvaffaqiyatga erishgan, ammo uzoq davom etmaydigan narsa.

cards.ex: When demand outstrips supply, prices tend to rise sharply.
cards.exUz: Talab taklifdan oshib ketganda, narxlar keskin oshishga moyil bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulotga bo'lgan talab uni ishlab chiqarish yoki yetkazib berish imkoniyatidan yuqori bo'lsa.

cards.ex: Building brand equity is crucial for long-term success in the market.
cards.exUz: Bozorda uzoq muddatli muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun brend qiymatini yaratish juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Brendning bozorda ega bo'lgan qadriyati va obro'si.

cards.ex: The factory churns out thousands of products every day.
cards.exUz: Fabrika har kuni minglab mahsulot ishlab chiqaradi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va katta miqdorda nimadir ishlab chiqarish.

cards.ex: In our society, consumerism is rife; people are constantly buying new things.
cards.exUz: Bizning jamiyatimizda iste'mol keng tarqalgan; odamlar doimo yangi narsalar sotib olishadi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatda iste'mol qilish juda keng tarqalgan va odamlar ko'p narsa sotib olishga moyil.

cards.ex: The movie featured obvious product placement, with characters drinking specific brands of soda.
cards.exUz: Filmda aniq mahsulotni joylashtirish aks etgan, qahramonlar ma'lum markadagi gazli ichimliklarni ichishgan.
cards.uzDef: Kinoda, televideniyeda yoki boshqa ommaviy axborot vositalarida mahsulotni ko'rsatish orqali reklama qilish.

cards.ex: People often follow the herd when it comes to buying the latest gadgets.
cards.exUz: Odamlar ko'pincha eng so'nggi gadjetlarni sotib olishda omonga ergashadilar.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilik nima qilsa, shuni qilish, o'z fikringga ega bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: There's a glut of cheap clothing on the market, making it hard for local manufacturers to compete.
cards.exUz: Bozorda arzon kiyim-kechaklarning ortiqcha miqdori mavjud bo'lib, mahalliy ishlab chiqaruvchilarning raqobatlashishini qiyinlashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Keragidan ortiq miqdorda nimadir mavjudligi.

cards.ex: The company is trying to cash in on the popularity of the new superhero movie.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi superqahramon filmining mashhurligidan foydalanib, pul topishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatdan yoki hodisadan foydalanib, tezda pul topish.

cards.ex: The marketing team created a detailed consumer profile to better target their advertising.
cards.exUz: Marketing jamoasi o'z reklamalarini yaxshiroq maqsad qilish uchun batafsil iste'molchi profilini yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Iste'molchining xususiyatlari, xohishlari va sotib olish odatlari haqidagi ma'lumot.

cards.ex: People with more disposable income tend to spend more on luxury goods.
cards.exUz: Erkin daromadi ko'proq bo'lgan odamlar hashamatli tovarlarga ko'proq pul sarflashga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Soliq va boshqa majburiy to'lovlardan keyin qolgan, sarflashga mo'ljallangan pul.
